---
title: "Manuscript: MPX NYC Intervention Strategy"
---


```{r}
#| fig-cap: "fig-placessexcontact"
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 10
#| label: fig-placessexcontact


labels_place_type <- c(
                      "concert"            = "Concert/Theatre/Show",
                      "theatre/show"       = "Concert/Theatre/Show",
                      "darkroom"           = "Dark Room/Sex Party",
                      "sex-party"          = "Dark Room/Sex Party",
                      "dance-party"        = "Dance Party",
                      "sport-game"         = "Sport Game",
                      "private-residence-" = "Private Residence",
                      "something-else"     = "Something Else"
                    )

labels_place_sex <- c(
                      "no"            = "Social Contact",
                      "yes"           = "Sexual Contact"
                    )
  


working_data <- targets::tar_read(places_data) %>%
                           mutate(placeType = factor(placeType, names(labels_place_type), labels_place_type)) %>%
                           mutate(placeSex  = factor(placeSex,  names(labels_place_sex),  labels_place_sex)) 
 

figure_n_counts <-  working_data %>%
                                group_by(placeSex) %>%
                                summarize(n = n() )



working_data  %>%
  arrange(placeType,  placeSex) %>%
  group_by(placeType, placeSex) %>%
  summarize(count = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(  placeSex) %>%
  mutate(proportion = count / sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(prop_label = scales::percent(proportion, accuracy = 1)) %>%
  ggplot() +
    geom_bar(aes(x = placeType, y = proportion, fill = placeType), stat = "identity", width = 1) +
    geom_text(aes(x = 0, y = -0.8, label = paste("n =", n)), data = figure_n_counts, size = 4) +
    facet_grid( . ~ placeSex, switch = "y") +
    coord_polar() +
    scale_fill_manual("", values = c(
                                      dark_blue, 
                                      light_blue, 
                                      dark_purple, 
                                      light_purple, 
                                      dark_pink, 
                                      light_pink, 
                                      light_green, 
                                      dark_green
                                      )
                      )    +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.text    = element_text( hjust = 0.5),
      strip.text.y  = element_text(),
      plot.margin   = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, "cm"),
      plot.title    = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
      ) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,0.25, 0.50, 1), limits = c(-0.8, 1)) +
    labs(
          title    = captions_and_titles("placessexcontact")$title,
          subtitle = captions_and_titles("placessexcontact")$subtitle,
          caption  = captions_and_titles("placessexcontact")$caption
          )
  




```
